results.name: Writer: protected .docx → edit → Save re-encrypts in place (msoffcrypto + HMAC verify); reopening asks for the password and shows the edit; change password → old one refused, new one works
Writer: protect a plain .docx (mismatched confirmation refused in the dialog), then remove the password → plain .docx again; the server refused plaintext over it until removal was explicit
Spreadsheet: protected .xlsx (Standard) → edit a cell → Save re-encrypts in place as Agile (msoffcrypto + HMAC verify), lossless patch kept the other sheets; reopening shows the edit
Spreadsheet: protect a plain .xlsx → encrypted; remove the password → plain lossless .xlsx again (no-edit parts byte-identical to the original)
adversary: a cancelled unlock can neither save over nor re-protect the original; Password… on a non-.xlsx workbook is disabled
no uncaught page errors during the TT48 sessions
